title: federation_reference_publication_other_key_settling_is_retryable_not_stale fails on Windows with "Access is denied (os error 5)" inspecting the test state's termal.sqlite-wal (500 instead of 201)
outcome: The test tests::federation_native_binding_proof::references::publication::federation_reference_publication_other_key_settling_is_retryable_not_stale passes deterministically on Windows under the full gate: the publish path does not fail with a 500 when inspecting the state path `…\termal-test-state-<id>\termal.sqlite-wal` meets a transient "Access is denied (os error 5)" (a WAL file held by SQLite or a concurrent reader on Windows), or the test fixture does not race the WAL file it inspects.
acceptance: A note records the failure mode from the 2026-10-22 gate test-d469702d (src/tests/federation_native_binding_proof/references/publication.rs:245, assertion 500 != 201; diagnostics REFERENCE_PUBLICATION_DIAGNOSTIC stage=publish.path_before_open io=PermissionDenied on termal.sqlite-wal under the worktree's .tmp test state) and classifies its cause: product (publish path treating a transient Windows WAL access denial as unresolved) or test fixture (the fixture inspecting the WAL file while SQLite holds it).

The confirmed cause is fixed without weakening the assertion, inflating timeouts or retrying blindly; the test passes in the full gate on Windows on the exact committed tree, and cargo test --bin termal is green.
